checks.name: required_columns
checks.expectation: all eight contracted columns are present

checks.name: timestamp_parse
checks.expectation: every timestamp reads as an ISO-8601 date and time

checks.name: required_values_complete
checks.expectation: required fields contain no missing values

checks.name: exact_row_uniqueness
checks.expectation: no row repeats every field of another row

checks.name: business_key_uniqueness
checks.expectation: each line-hour combination appears at most once in the file

checks.name: known_line_ids
checks.expectation: line_id is one of the three contracted production lines

checks.name: positive_energy
checks.expectation: energy_kwh is strictly positive for each active hourly period

checks.name: rejects_within_output
checks.expectation: rejected_units cannot exceed units_produced or be less than zero

checks.name: downtime_range
checks.expectation: downtime_min is between 0 and 60 minutes within an hourly period

checks.name: motor_temperature_review_range
checks.expectation: motor_temp_c sits between 40 and 100 under the course review rule, which is not an approved plant limit

checks.name: shift_matches_hour
checks.expectation: shift label matches the course schedule rule for the timestamp hour

checks.name: expected_line_hour_coverage
checks.expectation: each expected line has exactly 24 distinct hourly records

checks.name: output_during_full_downtime
checks.expectation: units_produced must be zero when downtime is sixty minutes
